name: FPP 8.x
description: Falcon Player (FPP) is a lightweight, optimized software designed to run on single-board computers and x86 systems for controlling pixel lighting sequences. FPP 8.x is a previous stable release.

notes.text: FPP requires a privileged container for hardware and systemd access.
Installation compiles FPP from source and takes 15–30 minutes depending on CPU speed.
FPP 8.x is a previous stable release. Consider FPP 9.x for new deployments.
